summary: You decide every PIM policy setting; PIM Manager changes none on its own.

new.title: You decide every policy setting
new.text: On the new Policy settings page and in Get Started, you choose Microsoft default, PIM Manager recommendation or Keep current per setting. A quick selection for all settings needs a typed confirmation.

new.title: Managed tenants can choose differently
new.text: In an MSP setup, the managing tenant's choices are the default, and a managed tenant can choose differently.

fixes.title: Every policy change needs a SuperAdmin
fixes.text: PIM Manager changes no policy on its own, and every resulting change waits for a SuperAdmin to approve it.

fixes.title: Unwanted held removals clear themselves
fixes.text: A held removal plan that is no longer wanted clears by itself on the next run.
